title: Plesiosaurus call (sound design from real animal recordings)
author: DigiZoo sound design from recordings by National Park Service; King L, Soltis J, Douglas-Hamilton I, Savage A, Vollrath F
changes: Movie-style dinosaur call: no recordings of dinosaurs exist, so it was designed from real animal recordings (humpback whale calls pitched down over an African elephant rumble, layered). Sound design from 2 real recordings: "Humpback Whale (NPS Sound Gallery)" 0.25–0.55 s, slowed to 0.6× speed (pitched down 40%); "Humpback Whale (NPS Sound Gallery)" 2.62–3.12 s, slowed to 0.6× speed (pitched down 40%), placed at 0.55 s; "Humpback Whale (NPS Sound Gallery)" 3.95–4.27 s, slowed to 0.6× speed (pitched down 40%), placed at 1.45 s; "Bee-Threat-Elicits-Alarm-Call-in-African-Elephants-pone.0010346.s003" 1.20–4.20 s, slowed to 0.9× speed (pitched down 10%); then mixed to mono, gentle 12 dB/oct high-pass at 35 Hz, low-passed at 5000 Hz, added reverb, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3.
